title: ShoppingBench: A Real-World Intent-Grounded Shopping Benchmark for LLM-based Agents

metrics.ASR: Absolute Success Rate: all task-specific product relevance and knowledge/shop/budget conditions must pass.
metrics.CAR: Cumulative Average of Product Relevance: partial product relevance, not the Foundry canonical score.
metrics.overall_ASR: Paper-reported domain-weighted ASR; not a simple average of the four displayed task percentages.

task_mapping.web-live: Knowledge is the related original task, using Serper web search rather than this adaptation's GPT lookup.
task_mapping.web: No separate static-knowledge baseline in Table 1; do not duplicate the live Knowledge score as a static result.

comparability_limitations: Neither MAI-Code-1.1-Flash nor Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated in the original paper.
Original ASR and CAR are not identical to the Foundry canonical score or its strict-success flag.
Foundry uses a controlled 3636-document corpus and 30 development cases per task with three rollouts, unlike the paper's original catalog and 900-case test.
Do not compute cross-paper score deltas or claim a ranking between the different evaluation settings.
